title: settings.json
description: Per-user defaults of lrun (~/.lrun/settings.json, or LOCALRUN_SETTINGS), created by 'lrun settings'. Comments and trailing commas are allowed, key case is ignored, an unknown key fails. An option given on the command line always wins.

localNuget.description: Default of build --local-nuget (default: ~/.localnuget). Absolute, or starting with ~.

root.description: Default of build --root (default: the current directory). Absolute, or starting with ~.

stopTimeout.description: Default of up --stop-timeout: seconds up waits after Ctrl+C before killing what still runs (default: 10).

logLevel.description: Default of --log-level, for every command (default: Information). lrun ignores the case; these are the canonical names.
